verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's own Subscriptions product schedules recurring payment charges on a weekly, monthly or yearly cadence and retries rejected payments automatically, so it runs recurring automated work. That work is limited to billing, not general-purpose jobs or workflows. The MCP server and CLI let you operate subscriptions programmatically, but nothing documents a generic scheduler. Missing for 10: general-purpose recurring job or workflow scheduling beyond billing, cron-style triggers for arbitrary actions, agent- or AI-driven scheduled workflows, independent corroboration.
